title: Arcane Portal Over Ruins
description: A silhouetted wizard in flowing robes stands with arms raised before a massive glowing cosmic portal filled with swirling pink, purple and teal nebulae. Below is an intricate blue stone dungeon layout with glowing runes and magical circles.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a lone wizard in a flowing black cloak standing on ancient blue stone ruins with arms raised toward a giant swirling cosmic portal. The portal contains vibrant pink, purple and teal nebulae with a bright golden core. The stone dungeon below features glowing magical runes and circular patterns. Surreal watercolor style with colorful paint splashes and cosmic energy, fantasy illustration.
